date_code.status: published format; exact serial-family applicability should be checked
date_code.format: For Rheem HVAC equipment, Rheem says the first two digits after a letter in the middle or beginning of the serial are the week, and the next two digits are the year. Confirm the product's own label/model because serial layouts vary.
